subject: Re: Deployment mode follow-up — SSO, KMS/HSM & log retention
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@fintechco.com>
Cc: Alex Chen <alex.chen@fintechco.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Deployment call recap & next steps (SSO / KMS / Logging)

Thanks Sarah — really appreciate your time on the call this morning. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we stay aligned:

What we heard:
- Primary goal: embed Redwood inference into FinTechCo's customer workflows with strict compliance and auditability.
- Deployment options on the table: Hosted API (fastest), Dedicated capacity (customer-isolated GPUs), Private (VPC or on-prem for full control).
- Hard integration constraints called out:
  * SSO: Okta as IdP, SAML 2.0 required, SP-initiated preferred.
  * KMS/HSM: keys must be customer-managed; HSM-backed key storage is a hard requirement for some data classes.
  * Logging & retention: audit logs + request logs need to be retained for 7 years for compliance.
- Other: SOC 2 evidence and network architecture will be requested by your InfoSec team.

Immediate next steps (proposed):
1) Internal SE deep-dive to validate BYOK/KMS/HSM options and logging architecture (I’m looping in Dylan).
2) I’ll share our SSO integration guide, a KMS/HSM architecture sketch, and a short pricing delta between Dedicated and Private.
3) Schedule a security deep-dive with FinTechCo InfoSec (we recommend 60–90 mins) to walk through architecture and contract language.

If you can confirm: (a) whether HSM needs to be on-prem vs cloud HSM, and (b) any specific retention/legal requirements beyond the 7 years mentioned, that’ll help us prepare the right materials.

I’ll attach the initial docs and follow up with calendar options for the security call.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0182

Attachments: redwood_sso_integration_guide.pdf (stub), redwood-enterprise-quote-FT-042.pdf (stub)

Thanks Marissa — great summary. A few clarifications from our side:

- SSO: Okta SP-initiated SAML is preferred; we'll share SP metadata once we have an integration spec.
- KMS/HSM: Keys must be customer-managed. Preferred approach is cloud HSM (AWS CloudHSM) in our account, but we may require an on-prem HSM for certain regulated data classes — I’ll confirm which datasets map to which requirement before the security call.
- Logging retention: 7 years across request logs and audit trails is required. Logs must be immutable and stored in our environment or a customer-controlled archive.

Can you also include: a short note on what Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private would look like from a KMS perspective, and a rough cost delta (ballpark) so we can validate with procurement?

I’ve looped in Alex from IT to surface any network or data residency constraints. Thanks — available for the security deep-dive Thursday or Friday next week.

— Sarah
Head of Security & Compliance, FinTechCo
sarah.nguyen@fintechco.com

Folks — looping you both in to get SE and pricing coverage. High-level asks from FinTechCo that we should validate:
- Support SP-initiated SAML with Okta (should be straightforward)
- BYOK requirement with HSM backing (customer-managed) — need to confirm if we can do cloud HSM in customer account vs requiring Private for on-prem HSM
- 7-year immutable logging requirement; customer needs archive control

Dylan — can you confirm:
1) If Dedicated can be configured to use customer-managed keys (BYOK) with cloud HSM in customer account (AWS/Azure/GCP variants)? Any constraints/limitations?
2) If Private (VPC/on-prem) is required for on-prem HSM, how much engineering lead time are we looking at (ballpark)?
3) Notes on where long-term logs would be stored and estimated storage/ingest cost impact for 7-year retention (we’ll include in quote).

Lauren — please prepare a short price delta summary between Dedicated (with BYOK) and Private (on-prem/VPC) for procurement. I’ll consolidate and send to Sarah.

Thanks — aiming to have draft docs and a proposed security call time by EOD tomorrow.

Marissa

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@fintechco.com>, Alex Chen <alex.chen@fintechco.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Deployment call recap & next steps — please review (SSO/KMS/log retention)

Thanks for the context — summary from SE perspective below. I’m attaching two reference stubs (kms_hsm_design.png, sso_integration_notes.txt) for the security call.

Short answers to Marissa’s questions:
1) Dedicated + BYOK: Yes — we can support customer-managed keys using cloud HSM in the customer’s cloud account for Dedicated. That gives FinTechCo control of key material while keeping Redwood-managed inference nodes isolated to the dedicated pool. Caveats: cross-account networking and KMS IAM policies need to be defined; there’s additional ops+onboarding time (1–2 weeks) to validate key rotation and access controls.
2) Private (VPC/on-prem) & on-prem HSM: If FinTechCo requires an on-prem HSM, Private deployment is the recommended path. On-prem HSM integration is possible but requires network/VPN prep, cert exchange, and an SRE window for deployment. Engineering lead time typically 6–8 weeks depending on customer-side readiness.
3) Logging retention: We can stream request logs and audit logs to a customer-controlled bucket (S3/GCS) or into their SIEM (e.g., Splunk). Long-term immutable storage (7 years) is supported by directing logs to the customer archive; Redwood can provide retention policies and checksums, but the storage costs for 7 years will be billed separately. Expect storage delta to be material — we should model it explicitly in the quote.

Ballpark cost deltas (very high level):
- Hosted API: baseline pricing, fastest to onboard, does NOT meet BYOK/HSM or long-term customer-controlled immutable archive requirements.
- Dedicated + BYOK: ~+30% on top of Hosted baseline for reserved capacity + onboarding + KMS integration fees.
- Private (VPC/on-prem) with on-prem HSM: ~+80–120% of Hosted baseline depending on connectivity and runbook complexity; includes longer deployment lead time.

Recommended next steps:
- Security deep-dive (60–90 mins) to validate network requirements, KMS flows, and logging architecture.
- Prepare a short appendix for the contract (BYOK, KMS responsibilities, log custody, SLAs).

I’ll send the stubs now and can be on the security call to walk through the diagrams.

— Dylan Brooks
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
